carpet.rule.autoMending.name: Automatic Mending
carpet.rule.autoMending.desc: Automatically repairs one damaged Mending item per second (fully). Spends XP banked in the experience bar first, and draws from experience levels when the bar runs short; only stops once the player is out of XP entirely
carpet.rule.voidWarehouse.name: Void Warehouse
carpet.rule.voidWarehouse.desc: A crafting table renamed via anvil becomes a server-wide shared warehouse
carpet.rule.voidWarehouseRestock.name: Void Warehouse Restock
carpet.rule.voidWarehouseRestock.desc: Lets a printer that ran out of blocks while building take a full stack straight from the Void Warehouse. Warning: while enabled, any player with a compatible printer can draw from the shared stock
carpet.rule.concretePowderToGlass.name: Smelt Concrete Powder Into Stained Glass
carpet.rule.concretePowderToGlass.desc: Lets a regular furnace smelt all 16 concrete powder colours into the matching stained glass (0.1 xp / 200 ticks, same as sand into glass). Only regular furnaces are affected; blast furnaces and smokers still reject concrete powder
